title: Dow Jones Futures Rise, Oil Prices Dive Below $100 On Report That U.S.-Iran Deal Close; AMD Soars On Earnings
title_zh: 美伊协议结束，道琼斯期货上涨，油价跌破 100 美元； AMD 盈利飙升
summary: Dow Jones futures: President Trump "paused" his Hormuz effort with a U.S.-Iran deal reportedly close. AI stocks AMD, Astera Labs jumped on earnings.
summary_zh: 道琼斯期货：特朗普总统“暂停”了霍尔木兹的努力，据报道美伊协议已经接近。人工智能股 AMD、Astera Labs 因盈利而上涨。

title: Bloom Energy (BE) Valuation Check As Strong Q1 2026 Results And Oracle AI Deal Lift Expectations
title_zh: Bloom Energy (BE) 估值检查 2026 年第一季度业绩强劲，Oracle AI 交易提升预期
summary: Bloom Energy (BE) has jumped into focus after a busy late April, with Q1 2026 earnings beating analyst expectations, full year guidance raised to US$3.4b to US$3.8b, and an expanded Oracle partnership for AI data center power. See our latest analysis for Bloom Energy.
summary_zh: Bloom Energy (BE) 在经历了 4 月底的繁忙之后，成为人们关注的焦点，其 2026 年第一季度收益超出了分析师预期，全年指引提高至 3.4 亿美元至 3.8 亿美元，并且扩大了 Oracle 在人工智能数据中心电力方面的合作伙伴关系。请参阅我们对 Bloom...

title: Alphabet stock climbs 2% on report of massive Anthropic deal
title_zh: Anthropic 大规模交易报道导致 Alphabet 股价上涨 2%
summary: Investing.com -- Alphabet Inc. (NASDAQ:GOOGL) rose 2% in after-hours trading Tuesday following a report that Anthropic has committed to spending approximately $200 billion with Google Cloud over the next five years.
summary_zh: Investing.com——Alphabet Inc.（纳斯达克股票代码：GOOGL）周二盘后交易中上涨 2%，此前有报道称 Anthropic 承诺在未来五年内向 Google Cloud 投入约 2000 亿美元。

title: Alphabet Returns to Euro Debt Market for Latest AI Megabond Deal
title_zh: Alphabet 重返欧元债券市场进行最新人工智能超级债券交易
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Alphabet Inc. needs to borrow heavily to fund investments in artificial intelligence, and it’s increasingly tapping every market to do so.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——Alphabet Inc. 需要大量借贷来资助人工智能投资，并且它正在越来越多地利用各个市场来实现这一目标。
